- **Episode navigation.** Go to the previous or next episode, or pick an exact
  one from a list that stays hidden until you expand it. Works on AnimeWorld,
  in Chrome on Skipper Screen and in the browser extension, including long
  series split in ranges of 50. More sites are a config entry each
  (`sites.json` / `recipes.json`), not a new release.
- **English by default, Italian selectable.** Both Android apps now start in
  English whatever the phone's language; switch to Italian in Settings (remote)
  or on the main screen (Skipper Screen).
- **Update from inside the app (Android).** The update banner on the remote now
  downloads and installs the new version itself, and Skipper Screen has the same
  in its main screen. Android asks once to allow installs from the app. Versions
  before 0.4.0 can't do this, so install 0.4.0 by hand once; the browser
  extension still updates as before.
- **The pairing QR code opens the app.** It used to show up as a plain string in
  camera apps; it now opens a page that hands off to Skipper.
